- Repeating pattern: jumping straight into implementation without naming the underlying trade-off first.
- Writing concise mental models after reading helps recall better than saving long highlight dumps.

# Distributed Consensus Notes

## Earlier Highlights (already reviewed)
- Raft separates leader election from log replication to simplify reasoning.

## New Highlights (2026-11-22)
- Lease-based linearizable reads fail safely only when clock drift bounds are enforced across all nodes; otherwise a partitioned former leader can serve stale reads.
